subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Purpose of Corporate Governance
description: A fast breakdown of The Purpose of Corporate Governance for builders.

hook.text: Shareholders own the company but managers run it. What stops managers from enriching themselves instead?

buildup.text: Corporate governance is the system of rules and practices that ensures companies are run in shareholders' interests.

discovery.text: Good governance means transparency, accountability, and fair treatment of all stakeholders.

twist.text: Without governance, executives can award themselves huge bonuses while the company declines.

climax.text: Governance is the immune system of a corporation. Without it, self-interest becomes a disease.

punchline.text: Owners can't watch daily. Governance watches for them.

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of corporate governance?
options: Ensuring companies are run in stakeholders' interests
